Applicant :- Ayushi Agrawal
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Ravi Srivastava,Dileep Kumar Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Dileep Kumar Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Ravi Kant Kushwaha,
learned A.G.A. for the State-respondent.

2.  The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.54 of 2017, under Sections 420, 409, 467, 468, 471, 120-B, 34IPC and 3, 4, 5, 6 Prize Chits and Money Circulation Scheme Banning Act, 1978, Police Station- Hafizpur, District- Hapur, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

entities.text: Prize Chits and Money Circulation Scheme Banning Act, 1978
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
3. FIR of the present case was lodged under Section 420, 406 IPC against Ablaze info Solution Pvt.
Ltd. and according to the allegation, informant invested Rs.11,500/- in the company and his money was misappropriated by playing fraud.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant has been made accused in the present matter only due to reason that she was one of the director of the company and there is no evidence against the applicant that either she induced the informant to invest the money in the company or she received the money from him.

He further submitted that applicant is not the sole director of the Ayushi Agrawal vs State Of U.P. on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102662855/
1 company and there are other directors also and she is in jail since 26.12.2017 i.e. for last about more than 5 years.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
He further submitted that against the company Ablaze info Solution Pvt. Ltd. there are as many as 300 FIRs were lodged and being director of the company applicant was also made accused in as many as 58 other cases and her criminal history has been explained in paragraph nos.
26, 27 to the affidavit filed in support of the present bail application.

5. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is one of the director of the company but could not dispute the fact that applicant is in jail for last more than 5 years.
6.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

7. Although, there is allegation against the applicant that she is director of Ablaze info Solution Pvt.
Ltd. and the company duped the huge amount of the informant and others and number of FIRs were lodged against the company and applicant is also having criminal history of about 58 other cases but it appears that in these cases she has been made accused due to this reason that she is one of the director of the Ablaze info Solution Pvt. Ltd. and her criminal history has been explained in paragraph nos. 26 and 27 of the affidavit filed in support of the present bail application and all the offences are triable by Magistrate-I Class and applicant is in jail since 26.12.2017 in the present case i.e. for last more than five years, therefore, considering the long incarceration of the applicant, in my view applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

8. In the light of discussions made above, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case,
the instant bail application is allowed.

9. Let the applicant- Ayushi Agrawal be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
10. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

Order Date :- 22.5.2023 Zafar  Ayushi Agrawal vs State Of U.P. on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102662855/
